tasks.title: Python and uv project setup
tasks.description: Provide an installable Python project managed with uv.
acceptance_criteria: Project metadata and dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
A uv lockfile records the resolved environment.
The reaper-mcp command is exposed as a project script.

tasks.title: MCP server over stdio
tasks.description: Run the external REAPER MCP server using stdio transport.
acceptance_criteria: The server registers typed MCP tools.
The server starts with stdio transport.
The external server does not call REAPER RPR APIs directly.

tasks.title: REAPER Python ReaScript bridge
tasks.description: Run a deferred Python ReaScript inside REAPER to own REAPER API access.
acceptance_criteria: The bridge listens for requests while running inside REAPER.
Direct RPR API calls remain inside reaper/mcp_bridge.py.
Commands are resolved through COMMAND_HANDLERS and unknown commands return structured errors.

tasks.title: Reliable TCP and JSON bridge transport
tasks.description: Connect the external MCP server to the REAPER bridge over finite-timeout TCP and JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Requests are sent as JSON to 127.0.0.1:8765.
The bridge client uses a finite connection and socket timeout.
Responses are read in multiple chunks until EOF before JSON decoding.

tasks.title: Bridge validation and deployment script
tasks.description: Validate and deploy the repository bridge to REAPER's Scripts directory.
acceptance_criteria: The script validates bridge syntax with the uv-managed Python environment.
Deployment stops when syntax validation fails.
A valid bridge is copied to the configured REAPER Scripts path.

tasks.title: Repository contribution workflow
tasks.description: Define repository-local validation, deployment, commit, and push rules.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md documents architecture and validation requirements.
Bridge changes require successful syntax validation and deployment before commit.
Only task-related files are staged, committed, and pushed to the configured upstream.

tasks.title: REAPER MCP capability skill
tasks.description: Provide a repository-local Codex skill for safely extending REAPER MCP capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The add-reaper-mcp-capability skill exists under .codex/skills.
The skill preserves the MCP, TCP/JSON, bridge, and REAPER API boundary.
The skill requires repository validation, deployment, and Git completion workflows.

tasks.title: Backlog web visualizer
tasks.description: Provide a browser-based dashboard for exploring the repository backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Load tasks directly from tasks/backlog.json through a local static web server.
Show overall progress, summary metrics, task cards, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
Support search plus status, category, and priority filters.

tasks.title: Backlog visualizer launcher
tasks.description: Launch the existing backlog visualizer with one repository-relative PowerShell command.
acceptance_criteria: Derive the repository root from the script location without hardcoded repository paths.
Start the tasks static server from the correct working directory.
Print a startup message and propagate a non-zero server exit code.

tasks.title: Backlog bug visualization
tasks.description: Display capability bug history within its corresponding backlog ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Render bug IDs, statuses, descriptions, discovery context, and fixing commits when available.
Use distinct open and fixed bug treatments.
Include bug content in backlog search results.

tasks.title: Four-column backlog layout
tasks.description: Use available desktop space more effectively with a four-column task grid.
acceptance_criteria: Show four task-card columns on sufficiently wide screens.
Reduce the grid responsively at tablet and mobile breakpoints.
Keep task content readable without horizontal overflow.

tasks.title: Backlog auto-refresh
tasks.description: Refresh backlog data automatically while the visualizer remains open.
acceptance_criteria: Fetch backlog.json periodically without requiring a manual page reload.
Bypass stale browser caches for refreshed backlog data.
Prevent overlapping refresh operations.

tasks.title: Backlog scroll preservation
tasks.description: Preserve the user's reading position across automatic and manual page refreshes.
acceptance_criteria: Restore the current scroll position after an automatic data refresh.
Persist and restore scroll position across a manual browser reload.
Avoid disrupting the active backlog browsing position.

tasks.title: Collapsible backlog bug panels
tasks.description: Allow bug details inside task cards to be expanded only when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Render each ticket's bug collection in a collapsible panel.
Show the bug count in the collapsed panel heading.
Preserve expanded bug panels during automatic refreshes.

tasks.title: Testing status visualization
tasks.description: Represent the backlog testing state consistently throughout the visualizer.
acceptance_criteria: Use a testing color distinct from completed and pending statuses.
Show a testing-ticket count with matching color in the summary panel.
Include testing in the status filter and calculate pending independently.

tasks.title: Backlog filter alignment
tasks.description: Align the backlog search field consistently with the other filter controls.
acceptance_criteria: Give the search control a visible label consistent with the select controls.
Align search and filter control tops and heights.
Preserve accessible labels for all toolbar controls.

tasks.title: Backlog refresh visibility and intake workflow
tasks.description: Improve refresh feedback and task-panel continuity while ensuring new repository work is represented in the backlog before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Show a compact countdown indicator driven by the existing automatic refresh interval and reset it after refresh.
Preserve expanded task sections across automatic and manual refreshes without corrupting state during filtering.
Require Codex to reuse or create an appropriately categorized backlog ticket before implementing requested work.

tasks.title: MCP connectivity ping
tasks.description: Confirm that the external MCP server is reachable.
acceptance_criteria: The ping MCP tool is discoverable.
Calling ping returns pong without mutating REAPER.

tasks.title: Get track count
tasks.description: Return the number of tracks in the active REAPER project.
acceptance_criteria: The MCP tool returns the active project's track count.
Track counting is performed through the REAPER bridge.
The operation does not mutate the project.

tasks.title: Get project information
tasks.description: Return basic state for the active REAPER project.
acceptance_criteria: The response includes project name, track count, tempo, and play state.
Playing, paused, recording, and stopped states are represented.
The operation does not mutate the project.

tasks.title: Get tracks
tasks.description: Return tracks with mix state and folder hierarchy information.
acceptance_criteria: Each track includes a one-based index, name, mute state, and solo state.
Each track preserves raw volume and pan values alongside dB, percentage, and direction representations.
Folder depth, folder status, nesting status, and parent track identity support multiple nesting levels.
The operation does not mutate tracks.

tasks.title: Get track FX chains
tasks.description: Return the FX chain for every track in the active project.
acceptance_criteria: Every track includes its one-based index, name, FX count, and FX list.
Each FX includes its one-based index, name, enabled state, and offline state.
Tracks with zero FX return an empty FX list without error.

tasks.title: Get all parameters for one FX
tasks.description: Inspect every exposed parameter for one selected track FX.
acceptance_criteria: One-based track and FX indexes are validated with structured errors.
The response includes track and FX identity plus parameter count.
Each parameter includes a one-based index, name, raw value, formatted value, minimum, maximum, and midpoint.
The operation does not modify FX parameters.

tasks.title: Get one FX parameter
tasks.description: Inspect one parameter without returning the entire FX parameter list.
acceptance_criteria: One-based track, FX, and parameter indexes are validated with structured errors.
The response identifies the track, FX, and parameter.
The response includes raw, formatted, minimum, maximum, and midpoint values.
The operation does not modify the parameter.

tasks.title: Get FX preset information
tasks.description: Inspect current preset metadata for one selected track FX.
acceptance_criteria: One-based track and FX indexes are validated with structured errors.
The response includes track and FX identity, current preset name, and preset count.
The operation does not select or modify presets.

tasks.title: Diagnose FX parameter formatting
tasks.description: Sample REAPER's normalized FX parameter formatter for one parameter.
acceptance_criteria: The target track, FX, and parameter are validated.
The response samples normalized values from 0.0 through 1.0 in 0.1 increments.
Each sample reports formatter success and the formatted value.
The diagnostic does not modify the parameter.

tasks.title: Set one FX parameter
tasks.description: Set one FX parameter using either a normalized or supported formatted value.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one of normalized_value or formatted_value is accepted and all target indexes are validated.
Normalized values must be finite and within 0.0 through 1.0.
Formatted mode and the separate set_fx_parameter_formatted MCP tool resolve continuous single-numeric displays through REAPER's formatter using deterministic bounded inversion.
Formatted matching ignores units while rejecting textual, multi-number, ambiguous, and unparseable values.
Success is reported only after normalized read-back verification, with requested, resolved, applied, and formatted values returned.

tasks.title: Get project markers and regions
tasks.description: Return separate marker and region collections from the active project.
acceptance_criteria: Markers and regions are returned in timeline order with zero-based REAPER enumeration indexes, one-based public indexes, and displayed numbers preserved separately.
Names, colors, seconds, durations, and region boundaries are returned, with empty arrays when none exist.
REAPER's time map supplies accumulated beats, measure, beat within measure, and time-signature context.
The operation does not modify markers or regions.

tasks.title: Get tempo map
tasks.description: Return tempo and time-signature changes from the active project.
acceptance_criteria: Return ordered tempo and time-signature events with one-based indexes, project times, BPM, effective and marker time signatures, and linear-tempo-change state.
Return musical positions derived from REAPER's time-map APIs.
Use REAPER's time-map APIs rather than deriving changes from a single BPM.
Return the effective initial project tempo and time signature when no explicit changes exist and do not mutate the tempo map.

bugs.description: get_tempo_map returns an empty array when the project has no explicit tempo/time-signature markers instead of returning the effective initial project tempo and time signature as the first entry.

tasks.title: Get track routing
tasks.description: Inspect sends, receives, and relevant routing state for project tracks.
acceptance_criteria: Return validated track identity and ordered send, receive, and hardware-output collections.
Preserve raw and human-readable mix, channel, MIDI, and explicit source/destination routing values.
Handle tracks without routing entries, reject invalid one-based track indexes, and do not mutate routing.

tasks.title: Extend tracks with recording state
tasks.description: Extend get_tracks with recording input, arm, and monitoring state.
acceptance_criteria: Each track reports record-arm, input assignment, and monitoring state using REAPER values.
Existing get_tracks fields and folder behavior remain unchanged.
The operation does not modify recording configuration.

tasks.title: Get track items
tasks.description: Return media items for one validated project track.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a one-based track index and return only that track's identity and items.
Include item start, end, duration, mute, lock, and selection state when available.
Include one-based start/end measures and beats derived from REAPER's time map.
Return empty item lists for empty tracks and do not mutate items.

bugs.description: get_track_items does not accept a track_index and returns items for every track instead of only the requested track.

tasks.title: Get selected tracks
tasks.description: Return tracks currently selected in REAPER.
acceptance_criteria: Return selected track indexes and names in project order.
Return an empty list when no tracks are selected.
Do not change track selection.

tasks.title: Get item information
tasks.description: Inspect one media item selected by track and item index.
acceptance_criteria: Validate one-based track and item indexes with structured errors.
Return item identity, timing, state, and source-related metadata available without mutation.
Include one-based start/end measures and beats derived from REAPER's time map.
Do not modify the item.

bugs.description: get_item_info closes the bridge response without JSON when reading an item with an active take, causing the MCP client to fail with a JSON decode error.

tasks.title: Get item takes
tasks.description: Return takes for one validated media item.
acceptance_criteria: Return ordered takes with one-based indexes, names, active state, and source type when available.
Handle items with no takes cleanly.
Do not change the active take or take contents.

tasks.title: Get MIDI summary
tasks.description: Summarize MIDI content for one validated take.
acceptance_criteria: Validate item and take targets and reject non-MIDI takes clearly.
Return note, control-change, and text or sysex event counts when available.
Do not modify MIDI data.

tasks.title: Get MIDI notes
tasks.description: Return note events for one validated MIDI take.
acceptance_criteria: Return ordered note events with raw pitch, standard note name, channel, velocity, timing, mute, and selection state.
Expose project-time and stably rounded human-readable musical positions through REAPER conversion APIs.
Do not modify MIDI notes.

tasks.title: Get track envelopes
tasks.description: Return automation envelopes available on one validated track.
acceptance_criteria: Require a public one-based track_index and return only that track's identity and ordered envelope metadata.
Include envelope name, visibility, arm, active, and scaling information when available.
Do not change envelope state.

tasks.title: Get envelope points
tasks.description: Return automation points for one validated track envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track and envelope indexes with structured errors.
Return ordered points with raw time, musical position, raw and REAPER-formatted values, shape, tension, and selection state.
Do not insert, delete, or modify envelope points.

bugs.description: get_envelope_points formats a Volume envelope point at 4.0 seconds as +57.1dB even though REAPER displays the point as 0.00 dB, because the raw point value is not being interpreted with the envelope's effective formatting semantics.

tasks.title: Get track channels
tasks.description: Inspect channel-count and channel-related configuration for tracks.
acceptance_criteria: Return each track's channel count and relevant channel configuration exposed by REAPER.
Preserve raw values when a human-readable mapping is also returned.
Do not change track channel configuration.

tasks.title: Get master track
tasks.description: Return mix and state information for the active project's master track.
acceptance_criteria: Return master track identity and useful volume, pan, mute, solo, and channel state.
Preserve raw and human-readable values consistently with get_tracks.
Do not modify the master track.

tasks.title: Get master FX
tasks.description: Return the active project's master-track FX chain.
acceptance_criteria: Return master FX count and ordered FX entries.
Each FX includes name, one-based index, enabled state, and offline state.
Handle an empty master FX chain and do not modify FX.

tasks.title: Get project time selection
tasks.description: Return the active project's current time selection.
acceptance_criteria: Return whether a time selection exists plus start, end, and duration in seconds.
Include REAPER-derived musical positions when reliable.
Do not change the time selection or loop points.

tasks.title: Get cursor position
tasks.description: Return the active project's edit cursor position.
acceptance_criteria: Return cursor position in seconds.
Include REAPER-derived beat, measure, and time-signature context when reliable.
Do not move the cursor.

tasks.title: Get current context
tasks.description: Return a focused snapshot of the user's current REAPER context.
acceptance_criteria: Return selected tracks, edit cursor, and time-selection context from existing focused readers.
Represent missing selections without errors.
Do not alter selection, cursor, or project state.

tasks.title: Get take FX
tasks.description: Return the FX chain for one validated media-item take.
acceptance_criteria: Validate item and take indexes with structured errors.
Return one-based FX indexes, names, enabled states, and offline states.
Handle takes with zero FX and do not modify the chain.

tasks.title: Set FX enabled state
tasks.description: Enable or bypass one validated track FX.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track, FX, and boolean input before mutation.
Perform only the requested enabled-state change through the bridge.
Read state back and report requested and applied values, reporting success only when verified.

tasks.title: Set track volume
tasks.description: Set volume for one validated track.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track and volume input without silently clamping invalid values.
Perform only the requested volume mutation through the bridge.
Read volume back and report requested and applied raw and human-readable values.

tasks.title: Set track pan
tasks.description: Set pan for one validated track.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track and pan input without silently clamping invalid values.
Perform only the requested pan mutation through the bridge.
Read pan back and report requested and applied raw and human-readable values.

tasks.title: Set track mute
tasks.description: Set mute state for one validated track.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track and boolean mute input before mutation.
Perform only the requested mute-state change through the bridge.
Read mute state back and report requested and applied values.

tasks.title: Set track solo
tasks.description: Set solo state for one validated track.
acceptance_criteria: Validate track and boolean solo input before mutation.
Perform only the requested solo-state change through the bridge.
Read solo state back and report requested and applied values.
